svg.title: Compute SGD, AdamW and Muon updates from six identical gradients
svg.desc: Supplied gradient 6 of 6. Three computed steps. Different shapes.. SGD, AdamW and Muon compute different updates from the same gradient sequence. Ellipses use unit Frobenius norm for display; raw norms and matrix entries are shown.
svg.text: Shapes show D / ‖D‖F; the numbers show the actual step.
Blue: image of (1, 0) · orange: image of (0, 1)
